instrument: BTC/USD spot — backtest only, no live orders placed (Phase 1 scope)

gates.wf_ratio_normalization: per-quarter, chronological split (train/test quarter counts vary by setup — see best.walk_forward)
gates.anchor_method: most-recent-quarter-with-trades P&L vs worst-prior-quarter P&L (no SPY-style anchor trades exist for crypto yet — this backtest is the first)

anchor_no_regression.method: most-recent-quarter-with-trades P&L vs worst-prior-quarter P&L (no SPY-style anchor trades exist for crypto yet — this backtest is the first)

op20_disclosures: 1. FIRST PASS: this is the first-ever crypto_paper backtest for TRENDLINE_RECLAIM — n=14 trades, small-sample. Treat with proportional skepticism (OP-33 / fable-too-good).

2. SIZING: fixed notional per trade (risk_pct_per_trade of a nominal $2,000 starting equity, NON-compounding across trades) so quarter-over-quarter $ P&L stays directly comparable — NOT a live/compounding equity curve.
3. NO LOOK-AHEAD (C6): signals computed from bars[0:i+1] only; entries fill at the NEXT bar's open (never the signal bar's own close/high/low).

4. INTRABAR ORDERING: a single OHLC bar cannot disambiguate which of (stop, target) printed first intrabar — structure/catastrophe stops are checked BEFORE profit targets every bar (conservative assumption, may understate best-case P&L).

5. ANCHOR-NO-REGRESSION REDEFINED: no SPY-style hand-labeled J-called crypto trades exist yet (this backtest IS the first pass) — the gate instead compares the most recent quarter's P&L against the worst prior quarter's.

6. BACKTEST ONLY: no order was placed, no broker was called, no account was touched. This package cannot place live orders as built (Phase 1 scope; live engine is Phase 3, gated on this ratification bar clearing AND a J-provisioned account).
